prompt:
Build a Simscape Multibody model of a six-wheel planetary rover that follows a supplied three-dimensional path over a supplied terrain, retrieves a sample with an onboard manipulator, and places it in onboard storage.

The rover must use a physically connected six-wheel rocker-bogie suspension with six distinct wheel-terrain contacts. Regulate rover speed and path tracking in closed loop through physical drive and steering actuation. Use six electric drive motors and four electric steering motors connected through their mechanical transmission paths. Include a physically articulated six-joint manipulator that performs sample pickup and storage. Controller and trajectory-generation methods are unrestricted.

Read RoverPath_XYZ, TerrainGrid_X_m, TerrainGrid_Y_m, TerrainGrid_Z_m, SamplePosition_m, TargetSpeed_mps, TerrainMuStatic, and TerrainMuDynamic from the MATLAB base workspace. RoverPath_XYZ is N-by-3 in metres. TerrainGrid_X_m, TerrainGrid_Y_m, and TerrainGrid_Z_m are Ny-by-Nx matrices with MATLAB meshgrid semantics: each row of TerrainGrid_X_m repeats the x coordinates, each column of TerrainGrid_Y_m repeats the y coordinates, and TerrainGrid_Z_m contains the corresponding terrain heights. SamplePosition_m is a reachable 1-by-3 position near the end of the supplied path. Support TargetSpeed_mps from 0.024 to 0.036 m/s, TerrainMuStatic from 0.64 to 0.80, and TerrainMuDynamic from 0.48 to 0.60.

The rover trajectory must result from wheel-terrain forces and feedback control rather than prescribed chassis motion or a replayed path. The sample mission must result from measured manipulator and sample interaction rather than replayed output signals. Energy reporting is required only for the six chassis drive motors and four chassis steering motors; it does not claim to include manipulator energy.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named rover_state, drive_wheel_state, steer_state, arm_joint_state, end_effector_position, sample_mission_state, chassis_motor_state, and chassis_energy. rover_state has 7 channels [x_m,y_m,z_m,roll_rad,pitch_rad,yaw_rad,speed_mps]. drive_wheel_state has 12 channels: angular speed for L1,L2,L3,R1,R2,R3 (rad/s), followed by torque for the same wheels (N*m). steer_state has 8 channels: angle for L1,L3,R1,R3 (rad), followed by applied torque for the same joints (N*m). arm_joint_state has 12 channels: q1..q6 followed by q1_command..q6_command, all in rad. end_effector_position has 3 channels [x,y,z] in m. sample_mission_state has 6 channels [sample x,y,z relative to the arm (m), pickup latched, stored latched, arm mode]. chassis_motor_state has 30 channels: drive-motor speeds for L1,L2,L3,R1,R2,R3 and steer-motor speeds for L1,L3,R1,R3 (rad/s), their torques in the same order (N*m), then their currents in the same order (A). chassis_energy has 3 channels [drive-motor power (W), steer-motor power (W), cumulative drive-and-steer energy (Wh)]. Each signal must be measured from, or causally derived from, the corresponding connected physical or control path.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO04.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
